mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TASK_ACT_INST( ACT_CODE, ACT_RECEIVER, ACT_RECEIVE_TM, ACT_HANDLER, ACT_HANDLE_TM, ACT_COMMENT, ACT_STATE, ACT_INST_ID, ACT_TASK_ID, ACT_MARK ) VALUES( #{actCode}, #{actReceiver}, #{actReceiveTm}, #{actHandler}, #{actHandleTm}, #{actComment}, #{actState}, #{actInstId}, #{actTaskId}, #{actMark} );
mapper.select: select act.ACT_ID as actId, act.ACT_CODE AS actCode, (select dc.DICT_CN_DESC from rm_sys_dict dc where dc.DICT_TYPE_CD='2001' and dc.DICT_CD=act.ACT_CODE) as actNode, case act.ACT_CODE when '20010001' then act. ACT_RECEIVER when '20010005' then (select uu.USER_NM from RM_SYS_USER_INFO uu where ta.HANDLE_PERSON=uu.USER_MOBILE) when '20010007' then (select uu.USER_NM from RM_SYS_USER_INFO uu where ta.HANDLE_PERSON=uu.USER_MOBILE) else (select GROUP_CONCAT(us.USER_NM SEPARATOR ",") from TASK_ACT_ASSIGNEE ass left join RM_SYS_USER_INFO us on ass.ASS_ASSIGNEE=us.USER_ID where ass.ASS_ACT_ID=act.ACT_ID) end as actReceiver, act.ACT_RECEIVE_TM as actReceiveTm, act.ACT_HANDLER as actHandler, act.ACT_HANDLE_TM as actHandleTm, DATE_FORMAT(act.ACT_HANDLE_TM,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s") as actHandleTime, act.ACT_COMMENT as actComment, act.ACT_STATE as actState, act.ACT_INST_ID as actInstId, act.ACT_MARK as actMark from TASK_ACT_INST act left join RM_TASK_INFO ta on ta.PROC_INST_ID=act.ACT_INST_ID where act.act_inst_id=#{procInstId}

SELECT ta.TASK_NAME as taskName, ve.VENUES_NAME as venuesName, ve.VENUES_ADDRES as venuesAddres, DATE_FORMAT(ta.LAUNCH_TIME,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as taskTime, DATE_FORMAT(ta.END_TIME,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as endTime, ta.FLOW_TYPE as flowType, case when us.USER_NM is not null then us.USER_NM else ma.MANAGER_CN_NM end as launchPerson, case when ta.HANDLE_RESULTS is null then '0' else ta.HANDLE_RESULTS end as handleResults, ta.TASK_CONTENT as taskContent, case ta.EMERGENCY_LEVEL when '01' then '紧急' when '02' then '普通' else ta.EMERGENCY_LEVEL end as emeLevelCn, ta.EMERGENCY_LEVEL as emeLevel, ta.LAUNCH_PERSON as launchMobil, '330000' as province, '330300' as city, us.area as area, case ta.REL_VENUES_ID!=us.area when ta.REL_VENUES_ID=ve.VENUES_ID then ve.town when ve.VENUES_ID is null then ta.REL_VENUES_ID else '' end as town, ta.REL_EVENT_ID as eventId, ta.TASK_PICTURE as taskPicture, if(ev.PICTURES_PATH is null,'',ev.PICTURES_PATH) as fileId FROM rm_task_info ta left join rm_venues_info ve on ve.VENUES_ID=ta.REL_VENUES_ID left join rm_sys_user_info us on us.USER_MOBILE=ta.LAUNCH_PERSON and us.VALID_IND='1' left join rm_venues_manager_info ma on ma.MANAGER_MOBILE=ta.LAUNCH_PERSON and ma.VALID_IND='1' left join RM_EVENT_INFO ev on ev.EVENT_ID=ta.REL_EVENT_ID where 1=1
and ta.PROC_INST_ID = #{procInstId}
